source: GitHub Actions run history of ploeffler/PersonalNewsHost: main (news.yml 100 runs over 26 days, short-updates.yml 100 runs over 23 days) and Full-featured-Newsoutlet (push workflows, 7 days). Wall-clock minutes per run; billing rounds every job up to whole minutes.

quota.note: Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free in public repositories. Private repositories on GitHub Free include 2000 Linux minutes per month.

news.yml.note: Hourly trigger; check_schedule.py stops early unless an edition is due (automation in config.json).

short-updates.yml.note: Speech and video tools are only installed when a breaking-news clip is due (T013).
